description: This Java class 'PayflowPro' provides a wrapper for integrating Verisign PayFlow Pro payment gateway API within an OFBiz project. It implements various payment operations such as credit card authorization, capture, void, refund, and PayPal express checkout functionalities, including response parsing and request building logic.

classes.name: PayflowPro
classes.description: A service class encapsulating payment processing methods via Verisign PayFlow Pro API, supporting functionalities like authorization, capture, void, refund, and PayPal express checkout workflows.

methods.name: ccProcessor
methods.description: Authorizes a credit card payment using the PayFlow Pro API, returns a response map with transaction details.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized transaction, returning the result and response details.

methods.name: ccVoid
methods.description: Voids a previous authorization or transaction, returning the result and response details.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Refunds a captured transaction, returning the refund status and details.

methods.name: setExpressCheckout
methods.description: Initializes an Express Checkout session with PayPal, requesting a token for user approval.

methods.name: getExpressCheckout
methods.description: Completes the Express Checkout process after user approval, obtaining transaction info and creating a payment method.

methods.name: doExpressCheckout
methods.description: Executes the PayPal transaction for the given token and payer info, updating the payment method accordingly.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses the response string from PayFlow Pro into a key-value map.

methods.name: parseAuthResponse
methods.description: Processes an authorization response, extracting result info, AVS, and CVV status.

methods.name: parseCaptureResponse
methods.description: Processes a capture response, extracting capture result details.

methods.name: parseVoidResponse
methods.description: Processes a void response, extracting void result details.

methods.name: parseRefundResponse
methods.description: Processes a refund response, extracting refund result details.

methods.name: parseContext
methods.description: Constructs URL parameter string from a context map for PayFlow API requests.

methods.name: makeBaseParams
methods.description: Builds common base parameters for PayFlow requests such as partner, vendor, user, and password.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes and configures a PayflowAPI instance with parameters from the payment gateway configuration.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves specific payment gateway configuration parameters from entity or properties.

methods.name: comparePaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Checks if a configuration value matches an expected string value.

methods.name: addCartDetails
methods.description: Adds shopping cart item details to the request parameter map for PayPal express checkout.
